title: Hamburg, Switzerland and the Archey band breaking up
summary: The tour went to Hamburg then Switzerland, where the band broke up after Archey joined Earl Hines in San Francisco; Waters forfeited his return ticket and stayed with Bill Coleman.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Where did the tour go with Jimmy Archey?
Hamburg - we started in Hamburg and played a week or somethin' like that in Hamburg. And then we looked for Hamburg - Switzerland - and the band broke up in Switzerland.
Yeah. [ ]. See, he went there - see, as far as my part concerned, see, because I could have went back. I had a ticket to go back, a round trip ticket. That -
Everybody in the band, I presume, had round trip tickets -
Had a round trip ticket. But I forfeited my ticket and stayed over with Bill Coleman. But because we only went for a month -
The tour was supposed to be a month -
One week in Hamburg, three weeks in Switzerland -
At the end of the three weeks in Switzerland Archey said the band wasn't goin' back to Ryan's, that they're be no gig if he went back -
He said he was going to join - which he did, he joined Earl Hines in the, he joined Earl Hines in the, in San Francisco at some club out there that they were working.
Sure, yeah, Earl was there for years -
With Muggsy Spanier and Morris Lane -
So then he, when he set back, the other guys don't have no jobs, see.
